query:
SELECT 
  c.id,
  c.claim_number,
  c.status,
  c.vehicle_make,
  c.vehicle_model,
  c.vehicle_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pbq.id) AS quote_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT qli.id) AS line_item_count,
  a.id AS assessment_id,
  a.status AS assessment_status
FROM claims c
LEFT JOIN panel_beater_quotes pbq ON pbq.claim_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN quote_line_items qli ON qli.claim_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN assessments a ON a.claim_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.claim_number, c.status, c.vehicle_make, c.vehicle_model, c.vehicle_year, a.id, a.status
ORDER BY quote_count DESC, line_item_count DESC
LIMIT 10;
